provenance: The Collection of Hanna and Simon Lifschutz Christie's London, 4 June 1997, lot 26 Acquired from the aboveHanna and Simon Lifshutz founded Vitrum Studios in Bombay, 1957. Simon Lifschutz lived in India for twenty-one years, during which time he revived industrial glass-making. These were the first studios in India to encourage young artists to work in ceramics and mosaics and create affordable work in an Indian idiom. They offered artists a livelihood and the freedom to develop their own style. Any artist was welcome to visit and work or teach there; prominent among them were K.H. Ara, K.K. Hebbar and Badri Narayan.
